messages:
Nina R.: deploy-bot froze the promotion for v3.0.0 — layer digest mismatch on artifact store, holding the 16:00 PT change window. https://ci.internal/rel/3210 :warning:

deploy-bot: Promotion frozen: release=v3.0.0; reason=layer_digest_mismatch; artifact=artifacts/2026/04/02/v3.0.0.bin; attempts=2; last_error='layer[4] digest expected=sha256:1122aabb got=sha256:ffee3344'

Omar (infra): quick check: origin reports expected digest, replica-c reports different digest for same layer index. content-length same. looks like a layer rewrite or a partial upload replaced the blob.

Teresa - Release Eng: options: 1) pin to previously-verified build (v3.0.0-stable), 2) pause and wait for infra to reconcile replicas, 3) rewrap artifact (repack layers & re-sign) and push — takes ~25m. We have public release notes scheduled for 17:00 PT.

Vik QA: last verified stable build passed full smoke and regression. I'm +pin if we can run a 10m canary and validate. Rewrap option seems riskier for timeline.

Omar (infra): if we pin, I'll open ticket STORAGE-442 and run replica repair in background. If rewrap chosen, I can kick an automated repack job but it'll bump the artifact signature and require re-verification. My preference: pin to v3.0.0-stable and reconcile.

Teresa - Release Eng: agree with pinning. Please ensure the release notes call out the pin and reconciliation work. deploy-bot suggested_action=pin; suggested_artifact=artifacts/2026/04/01/v3.0.0-stable.bin; suggested_tag=release/v3.0.0-stable; run `deploy-bot confirm-pin release/v3.0.0-stable` to proceed.

deploy-bot: suggestion recorded=pin -> release/v3.0.0-stable. Awaiting maintainers confirm.

Nina R.: approved. Omar please create STORAGE-442 and kick replica repair. Also kick promote from stable tag.

ci-bot: promote job queued: promote-7777. logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/promote-7777

Omar (infra): STORAGE-442 created: https://tracker/internal/STORAGE-442 assigned infra-storage. Starting replica repair and background fetch. Rewrap left as fallback.

ci-bot: promote-7777 -> SUCCESS. promoted_artifact=release/v3.0.0-stable.bin

deploy-bot: Promotion completed for release=v3.0.0; artifact=release/v3.0.0-stable.bin; promoted_by=promote-7777; time=2026-04-02T16:12:10Z :white_check_mark:

Vik QA: canary e2e started (10m). I'll post results.

Omar (infra): replica repair in progress. Will update STORAGE-442 with results; ETA ~18m. If repair fails, we will rewrap and re-sign as fallback.

Vik QA: canary smoke all green. performance and health checks within thresholds. Signing off. :rocket:

Teresa - Release Eng: release notes updated with: "Artifact pinned to previously-verified build due to transient layer digest mismatch across replicas; infra initiated replica repair (STORAGE-442). Follow-up to include automation to compare layer digests across replicas before promote." Slack announcement scheduled for 17:00 PT.

Nina R.: thanks team. Closing thread. Follow-ups: STORAGE-442 and an automation RFC in infra backlog to gate promotion on multi-replica digest agreement. :thumbsup:
